items.name: AlterTableTransactionBuilder
items.summary: Builder for constructing an [`AlterTableTransaction`] with schema evolution operations.

methods.name: add_column
methods.summary: Add a new top-level column to the table schema.

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build(self, _engine: &dyn Engine, committer: Box<dyn Committer>) -> DeltaResult<AlterTableTransaction>
methods.summary: Validate and apply schema operations, then build the [`AlterTableTransaction`].

methods.name: set_nullable
methods.summary: Change a column's nullability from NOT NULL to nullable. If the column is already nullable, the op is a no-op but still generates a commit.

methods.name: with_correlation_id
methods.signature: fn with_correlation_id(self, correlation_id: impl Into<Arc<str>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Attach an opaque, caller-supplied correlation id for joining the alter-table commit's metric events to the caller's own request or operation id. An empty id is treated as unset.

items.name: Modifying
items.summary: State after at least one operation has been added. `build()` is available. See [`Chainable`] for the operations available on this state.

items.name: Ready
items.summary: Initial state: `build()` is not yet available (at least one operation is required). See [`Chainable`] for the operations available on this state.

items.name: Chainable
items.summary: Marker trait for builder states that accept chainable schema operations. Grouping states under one bound lets each op (like `add_column`) live on a single `impl<S: Chainable>` block -- chainable states share the body rather than duplicatin…
